title: Vietnamese Bun Cha
steps: Mix sugar, fish sauce, vinegar, lime juice, water, chilli, and garlic for the sauce. Set aside.
Soak vermicelli noodles in boiling water per packet instructions, then drain.
Combine pork, fish sauce, sugar, scallions, garlic, pepper, and lemongrass.
Shape pork mixture into 6 small patties and pan-fry in oil on medium-high for 2.5 minutes per side.
Assemble bowls with noodles, lettuce, bean sprouts, carrots, herbs, and top with meatballs.
Spoon the prepared sauce generously over the bowls before serving.
